subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should WhatsApp pairings switch to a Desktop browser identity by default even though existing affected sessions may need explicit re-pairing, or should the identity change initially be opt-in?
rationale: The source-level fix is bounded, but choosing an unconditional new pairing identity versus a compatibility mode determines the upgrade contract and operator action for existing linked accounts.

options.title: Desktop default with migration guidance
options.body: Change new pairings to the supported Desktop identity, detect or document affected existing sessions, and require a guided re-pair where necessary.

options.title: Explicit opt-in first
options.body: Preserve the current identity by default and add a temporary setting for operators to re-pair with the Desktop identity, accepting that group ingestion remains broken until configured.

recommendation.title: Desktop default with migration guidance
recommendation.body: Change new pairings to the supported Desktop identity, detect or document affected existing sessions, and require a guided re-pair where necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: The most directly relevant recent history is the WhatsApp reconnect and participating-group session work in the same module.
